name: print-preview-check
description: Check PNG print size and transparency with browser-local previews.

interface.longDescription: Open an interactive checker for a final PNG. Choose a print width to inspect pixel dimensions, effective PPI and transparency, then preview the artwork on illustrative products. Artwork selected inside the checker is processed in the browser; its pixels and measurements are not returned to the ChatGPT tool result. The checker does not certify print readiness. Synthetic examples are available without selecting a file.
defaultPrompt: Open Print Preview so I can inspect a PNG at my intended print width.
Show a synthetic print preview at 12 inches wide.
Measure the synthetic example at 20 cm wide.
